breakdown.description: The statement that cavitation is impossible contradicts the large positive suction head; sigma can become small or even negative depending on installation and head.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error by concluding 'cavitation is impossible for this turbine runner.' It ignores the 20 m installation height above the tailrace (hs = 20 m) which should appear in Thoma's sigma formula as sigma = (Ha - Hv - hs)/H = (10.3 - 0.3 - 20)/H = -10/H, yielding a negative sigma. The ground truth states that sigma can become small or negative depending on installation and head, and recommends reducing hs. The agent's formula omits hs entirely and arrives at the wrong conclusion.
